{{Infobox auto}}

'''Canned apples''' are the preservation of the [[apple]]. They heal {{Value|Canned Apples|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Canned Apples|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/canned_apples.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Apple|baked apple]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining a baked apple unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating canned apples takes {{Value|Canned Apples|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Canned Apples|heals}} and gives Regeneration {{Value|Canned Apples|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Canned Apples|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
